maddeler.e:
نتراجع (form VI)
# نَتَرَاجَعُ (natarājaʕu) /na.ta.raː.d͡ʒa.ʕu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of تَرَاجَعَ (tarājaʕa)
# نَتَرَاجَعَ (natarājaʕa) /na.ta.raː.d͡ʒa.ʕa/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of تَرَاجَعَ (tarājaʕa)
# نَتَرَاجَعْ (natarājaʕ) /na.ta.raː.d͡ʒaʕ/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of تَرَاجَعَ (tarājaʕa)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
